notes.content:
[list]

[/list]

On sale now is the much-praised 3D platformer, Glyph. Switch owners and Steam surfers can get this hidden gem of an old-school platformer at a deep discount of forty percent. The sale runs from November 24th until November 30th.

Glyph is likely to be "the best game you suck at". If that is the case - visit our store page and drop a vote on us in that category.

Regardless: Bolverk Games wish everyone a happy thanksgiving!

Our new Twitch channel, Bolverk Games PLAYGROUND, reaches affiliate status after a week of intense streaming.

Bolverk Games PLAYGROUND received the Twitch Affiliate credentials after a week of sometimes erratic, sometimes chaotic, but always intense... streaming.

“The playground is where we have fun with our current games, our old titles, where we host fun events and showcase what is on the way from the studio,” says Marketing Manager, Rasmus Jensen, who is also the fortunate soul to get paid for playing while commenting on games every day.

Bolverk Games PLAYGROUND exists to create a space where Bolverk Games as creators can connect and interact with players.

“As an indie studio, we enjoy a lot of freedoms, including being eye level with the people who have fun with our games. We have the freedom to be ourselves!” Mr. Jensen continues. He encourages everyone to visit the channel: https://bit.ly/BolverkPlayground

At the moment PLAYGROUND mostly features the latest release from Bolverk Games, Glyph, which recently had yet another 100% review naming the 3D platformer [b]"one of the best indie games of the year!" [/b] - Toisto.net

Other titles, including the tower defense game Kittypocalypse, will be shown on the channel soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40160365/03379b0e269d43aa9f7cacaea8a770cb23062629.png[/img]

[b]About Glyph[/b]
Glyph is a colorful and atmospheric 3D platformer game.

You play as a sphere-shaped mechanical scarab, named Glyph, from a third-person perspective. The player has to practice precision, speed, and ingenuity to collect relics and artifacts while exploring a series of highly varied, charming, and tricky non-linear levels.

The end goal is to advance through the levels and restore the ancient temple city of Aruu, buried in the desert. Aruu also functions as the game´s non-linear hub world.

Glyph appeals to both chill-out players and speedrunners as the open world allows for creative ways to move through the 80+ levels available with the release.

[b]Our company[/b]
Bolverk Games is a self-supporting indie studio based in Denmark and focused on VR games and software, but over the past year, we have been working on a 3D platform game for the Nintendo Switch console, Glyph.

We make beautiful, challenging, and immersive games. Bolverk was among the first to realize how VR gaming could be more than a novelty, and we are still at the forefront of a growing market, always exploring VR’s potential.

notes.title: Glyph quality of life update: Get updated on this summers' new stuff
notes.content:
Taking advice from our fantastic Glyph community on our Discord Feedback channel, we have enabled several new features and improvements over the summer. These changes have been put into effect in an ongoing fashion, thus experienced players are unlikely to find anything new. We're just really slow to announce these things.

Indeed, with time, more bugs will need squashing, and more fans will need squishing (hugging) for bringing these little critters to our attention. Thanks all! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Quality of life updates[/h1]
Level selection is now possible directly from the main menu
Progress overview available in the main menu
Level reshuffle for smoother difficulty progression
Lowered Time Trial requirements for silver and bronze awards
Players no longer lose all collectibles upon death (only keys are lost)

[h2]Also: New on the Discord server[/h2]
Weekly speedrunning challenges
Weekly Shutterbug (screenshot) challenges
The amazing Fanart channel
The new Live-Stream channel

[h2]Also: New on the Steam store page[/h2]
New accolades video
New gameplay video with voiceover
New screenshots added

[h2]Other minor stuff[/h2]
Various graphical enhancements
Minor level design changes
Bugfixes ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: For even more Glyph challenges, join our Discord Community!
notes.content:
[h2]Why not join our Glyph Discord Community and take part in the weekly challenges? [/h2]

[h3]Every week, we post new challenges on our Discord Server, which offers hours of entertainment both for those who enjoy the speedrunning, but also for those who prefer to take things a little slower and enjoy going sightseeing![/h3] --> https://discord.gg/FCQj4C5

[b]Speedrunning Challenges [/b]- Perfect for those who enjoy the thrill and competitive nature of Glyph. Every week the best in the world goes head to head, competing to be the #1 Speedmaster. 

[b]Shutterbug Challenges [/b]- With +80 levels in Glyph, there is plenty of stuff to see and explore. So, why not slow down and appreciate the beauty and variety of the game? As part of our weekly Shutterbug challenges, we go sightseeing in Glyph and take safari pictures to compete to become the #1 Shutterbug.

[b]Fanart Challenges [/b]- These weekly Fanart challenges will suit anyone who is bursting with creativity. You can paint! Draw! Photoshop! Edit! Use macaroni! Perform skywriting! Anything you want! As long as it is "Art," it is welcome in the weekly fanart challenges. Who knows? You might just have what it takes to become the #1 Artmaster. 

If any of these activities appeal to you, or just if you'd like to be a part of a fun and thriving video game community, then join the Glyph Discord Server! We'll look forward to welcoming you! -->  [https://discord.gg/FCQj4C5
